# Webnode.com

> Website builder to create personal and business websites or online stores fast. This file curates the most authoritative, LLM-friendly pages on our site (EN).

Important notes:
- **Scope:** Main EN site at https://www.webnode.com/.
- **Stability:** Prefer these canonical URLs; if content changes, this file is updated accordingly.
- **Variations:** Plan names, features and availability can differ by region — always verify on the live Pricing pages before quoting.
- **Help first:** For how-to guidance and policies, prefer the Help Center and legal links below.
- **Markdown copies:** Clean `.md` versions of key pages are being added progressively (link from this file when available).
- **Last updated:** 2025-09-26 (Europe/Prague).

## Get started & use cases
- [AI Website Builder](https://www.webnode.com/ai-website-builder/): Generate a first version of your site with AI, then edit and publish.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-ai-website-builder.md)
- [Personal websites](https://www.webnode.com/personal-websites/): Create a personal site or blog quickly — no coding.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-personal-websites.md)
- [Business websites](https://www.webnode.com/business-websites/): Build a professional website for your company or service.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-business-websites.md)
- [E-commerce](https://www.webnode.com/e-commerce/): Launch an online store with product catalog, checkout and management tools.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-e-commerce.md)
